title: Conference: Footprints of Gisbertus Voetius – his teachings, networks and legacies
speaker: Keynotes: Han van Ruler, George Harinck, Polly Ha, Jo Spaans
location: Thu: Boothstraat Kerk, Boothstraat 7 · Fri: Johanna Hudiggebouw, Kromme Nieuwegracht 47E
description: International conference marking 350 years since the death of Gisbertus Voetius (1589-1676), theology professor and rector of Utrecht University: his teachings, networks and legacies, in parallel panels with some 30 speakers. Organised by Andreas Beck, Aza Goudriaan, Fred van Lieburg and Dirk van Miert; co-sponsored by the Descartes Centre. To register, e-mail Aza Goudriaan (agoudrian@pthu.nl).
